text: Professional Overview：The major of Fine Arts Education belongs to the education category within the broad category of education and physical education. The professional level is junior college (higher vocational education), and the basic duration of study is three years. This major mainly studies the basic theories related to fine arts, enabling students to master scientific educational theories and teaching methods, receive training in the basic qualities and abilities of teachers, cultivate students' ability to organize extracurricular fine arts activities, equip them with initial research and creation capabilities, understand the development trends and cutting-edge topics of fine arts education at home and abroad, and initially master a foreign language. Be able to read foreign language books and periodicals of this major.Training Objectives：This major is dedicated to cultivating well-rounded talents in terms of morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics and labor. The training objectives of different schools vary in focus. Generally speaking, they aim to cultivate students with a solid foundation in science and culture, as well as ideological and political theories, basic theories of education and teaching, and knowledge of fine arts, who possess good humanistic and scientific qualities and innovative consciousness, and have strong abilities in curriculum design and implementation, class construction and management, application of digital educational technology, and lifelong learning. High-quality educators with a spirit of craftsmanship and information literacy, who are capable of engaging in art education and teaching in primary schools, kindergartens and other fields.
